files.base.ini:
# site defaults
name = orchard
root = /srv/${name}

[paths]
data = ${root}/data      ; where things live
logs = ${paths.data}/logs
tmp = "/tmp/${name} scratch"

[service.web]
port = 8080
url = http://${host}:${port}/   # host comes from global
flags = --fast \
        --safe \
        --quiet
motd = 'literal ${name} costs $5'
files.host.ini:
host = web-01.internal
[service.web]
port = 9090
flags += --verbose
!unset motd
[paths]
!unset tmp
cache = ${data}/cache#1

stdout:
[global]
host = web-01.internal
name = orchard
root = /srv/orchard

[paths]
cache = "/srv/orchard/data/cache#1"
data = /srv/orchard/data
logs = /srv/orchard/data/logs

[service.web]
flags = --fast --safe --quiet --verbose
port = 9090
url = http://web-01.internal:9090/
